app.name: Mashkif
app.tagline: Mashkif · Internet outage map for Israel

home.heading: Is it just me or everyone?
home.privacy: Mashkif watches the network, not you

admin.title: Admin
admin.viaPasswordTotp: Signed in with your password and a code.

setup.heading: Create the admin account
setup.intro: Mashkif has one admin. Get a setup token on the server, then choose a username and a password.
setup.tokenHelp: On the server, run this command. The token works once, for 15 minutes.
setup.command: docker compose exec app node server/dist/cli.js setup-token
setup.usernameHelp: 3 to 30 characters: English letters, digits, dots, or underscores.
setup.created: The account was created. Sign in to continue.

signIn.heading: Sign in
signIn.totpIntro: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for Mashkif.
signIn.lockedOut: Lost your password, authenticator, or passkey? On the server, run:
signIn.resetCommand: docker compose exec app node server/dist/cli.js reset-admin
signIn.endedIdle: You were signed out after an hour without activity. Sign in again.
signIn.endedMaxAge: Sessions last 12 hours. Sign in again.

totp.heading: Set up two-step verification
totp.intro: Every sign-in needs a code from an authenticator app. Set it up now to continue.
totp.confirmPassword: Confirm your password to create your personal code.
totp.scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
totp.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
totp.manual: Can't scan? Enter this key in the app:

passkeys.heading: Passkeys
passkeys.intro: Sign in with your fingerprint, face, or device PIN instead of a password and a code.
passkeys.name: Name (optional)

password.heading: Password
password.changed: The password was changed. Other sessions were signed out.

activity.heading: Recent security activity
activity.adminSetupTokenCreated: Setup token created on the server
activity.wayPassword: password only, to set up a code

errors.invalidCredentials: The username or password is wrong.
errors.invalidCode: The code is wrong. Enter the current code from your app.

errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait 5 minutes and try again.

errors.passwordTooLong: The password can have at most 128 characters.

errors.setupTokenInvalid: The setup token is wrong, used, or expired. Create a new one on the server.

errors.passkeyUserVerification: The passkey must confirm it's you with a PIN, fingerprint, or face. Try again or use your password.
errors.passkeyFailed: This passkey didn't work. Try again or use your password and a code.
